card.name: Capital H starting words in warnings
card.fires_on: The capital letter H beginning a word in all-caps boxed warning headings, such as HEPATITIS, HOSPITAL, HIGHER, HLA-B. Also responds to a split-off h before a word like hyperventilation.

modes.label: All-caps warning headings
modes.description: A split-off capital H opens a medical term in an all-caps warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACERBATION OF<< H>>EPATITIS B Severe acute

modes.label: Other H-initial terms
modes.description: An H starts a term outside the warning headings, in running text or a numbered heading.
modes.example: PT/INR utilizing an alternative method. 2. Evaluate for other causes of abnormally elevated PT/INR results. 7.1<< H>>MG-CoA Reductase Inhib

card.writes: It promotes tokens starting with Har or har, so it does not clearly suit the H-words it fires on.
card.plain: It fires on the letter H that begins a medical word in capitalized warning headings, like Hepatitis or Hematomas.
